newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER 42-0 AT TEA NEED 219 VS NORTHERNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER 42-0 AT TEA NEED 219 VS NORTHERNS.

text.p: Border were 42 without loss after 18 overs at tea, needing 219 in 65 overs for victory, on the final day of their four-day Supersport Series match against Northern Transvaal at Centurion Park on Monday.
Scores: Northern Transvaal 334-7 declared & 155 (Andre Seymore 58, Piet Botha 5-35) Border 271-5 declared & 42-0.
